Complete [[Blacktide Den]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Take [[Tahlkora]] and stop the general from making a deal with the [[Corsair]]s in [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den]].
* *BONUS* Kill five [[Rinkhal Monitor]]s.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* 100 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Blacktide_Den#Walkthrough|Blacktide Den]] mission.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Mission
:''"We have reason to believe the [[Kourna]]n military is conspiring with corsairs against [[Istan]]. A rendezvous is planned in the corsair campsite. Contact Tahlkora and infiltrate Blacktide Den. Stop that deal!"''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*In order to receive credit for the first bonus objective, you must complete the mission.

==Trivia==
*This quest was first offered on April 24, 2009.
